subject: Intro [SENDER] / [NAME]
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following [COMPANY]'s work on 4Sight, really impressive approach to 4D
LiDAR perception. I just moved to the Bay Area from Germany and would love
to meet in person to learn more about what you're building and where you're
taking the platform.

We've been partnering with teams like Woven by Toyota and Zipline to fuse
their 2D and 3D ML pipelines - not just to speed up development, but to
build long-term infrastructure for perception workflows.

I imagine [COMPANY] has a strong foundation already, but it could be valuable to
exchange perspectives and see if there's scope for collaboration now or
down the line.

Would you be open to a quick in-person chat next week? Thursday's open on
my side, and happy to come by your office. Looping in [SENDER] (CC) to
schedule for us.

subject: Encord - perception data annotation
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hamza mentioned it'd be good to connect with the AI team at [COMPANY].
Understood you checked out our platform in the past for annotation - was
wondering if the coming weeks might be a better time to connect?

Quick recap - we help physical AI teams e.g. 1X, Physical Intelligence and
Boston Dynamics improve annotation quality. They come to us when scaling up
real-world data collection effort - for more automated annotation pipelines
and integrated capabilities to curate datasets and send to labelling.

It'd be great to understand areas of the platform that aligns with your
current workflows at Maven. Would Friday morning work for a 30 mins chat?

subject: Coffee in Austin - Perception data accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

We just onboarded 1X, who like [COMPANY] is building models to understand &
interact with complex human environments. We'll be in Austin next week &
wanted to see if you'd be up for a coffee? Thought you might find what
we've learned interesting.

What Encord focuses on: improving data quality when real-world data
collection scales up. That's why we're unifying 2D and LiDAR annotation and
VLM captioning in one platform - a niche we developed with robotics teams
e.g. Physical Intelligence, Boston Dynamics, and Dyna Robotics.

Would you be open to exchange perspectives? We're in Austin Wed (10/19) to
Thurs (10/20) next week - can swing by your office or meet at a coffee shop
nearby.

subject: Coffee in Austin - autonomous driving data
text:
Congrats on your recent founding announcement - [NAME]! How are you
thinking about changing training data requirements as [COMPANY]'s L4 system &
delivery robots expand into different locations?

You might find our learnings with other autonomous driving teams (Woven by
Toyota, Wayve, Motional, etc.) interesting. From our perspective -
iteration speed is critical when it comes to improving perception model
performance in long tail scenarios.

We solve this by integrating data curation, autolabelling and human review
on 2D and point cloud data in one unified front end.

Our leadership team would love to exchange perspectives. They'll be in
Austin Wed (10/19) to Thurs (10/20) next week - would you be open for a
quick coffee?

subject: Coffee in Austin - surgical robot reliability
text:
Hi [NAME],

I wanted to reach out since our leadership team will be in Austin next
week. We work with surgical robotic teams e.g. Moon Sugrical, Kaliber Labs
and Telos Health who, similar to [COMPANY], are building high-precision
systems for operations - it'd be great to connect whilst we're in town!

For context - we help surgical AI teams improve annotation reliability.
With Encord, they can better orchestrate annotation to QA workflows, reduce
manual labelling times and refocus clinical expert effort on label quality.
We've also built our tool to capture the granularities of surgical contexts
- complex schema and coordination between modalities (image, video, DICOM,
NiFTI, etc.)

Our leadership team would love to exchange perspectives. They'll be in
Austin Wed (10/19) to Thurs (10/20) next week - would you be open for a
quick coffee?

subject: Thoughts on perception tooling
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following AEye's work on 4Sight, and it's a really impressive
approach to 4D LiDAR perception. Thought I'd reach out as I've recently
been working with teams from Woven by Toyota, Zipline, and Boston Dynamics
to fuse their 2D and 3D ML pipelines in Encord.

As a result, we've been building out LiDAR-specific functionality in close
collaboration with their AI teams, and are now looking to work with others
leading the space like AEye to help shape the next wave of perception
tooling.

Would you be open to a short chat to see the platform and share your
perspective? I'd love to get your candid feedback and compare notes on
where perception data infrastructure is heading.

I'm SF-based and happy to come by next week and give you a demo (Thursday's
open my side) - or we can set up a quick virtual call if easier.

subject: NeurIPS meet - up?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Are you going to be at NeurIPS this year? Would be great to meet for a
coffee and catch up.

You might find our learnings with other AI-powered camera teams
(Metropolis, Flock Safety, Milestone Systems) interesting. We focus on
helping them utilize camera data (especially video) to train AI models at
scale - with more efficient curation methods and annotation quality.

We'd love to exchange perspectives on building more accurate vision models.
Happy to put something on the calendar already - I am sure it's going to be
a busy week.

subject: NeurIPS - Private AI Leaders Dinner invite
text:
Hi [NAME],

Will you be at NeurIPS in San [SENDER] next month?

Encord is hosting an exclusive dinner to kick off the conference. In case you're not familiar with Encord - we're an SF and London-based data development platform (working with teams like Woven by Toyota, Skydio, Zipline, Dyna Robotics) built to help AI teams get better models to market, faster.

It'll be a group of other AI/ML leaders from across the industry at dinner, so it will be a great way to meet different people. We'd love to have you there if you're available and interested.

Key details:
2 December, 6.30pm - 9pm Herb and Wood: [LINK] (top rated restaurant in San [SENDER]) Exclusive room and bar for 30+ AI leaders Let me know if you'd like to join us, and I'll send you the invite.

subject: Finding specific data within logs
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've spoken so some of your colleagues in the perception team in regard to
the in-house ML tooling and a few of the challenges around finding specific
data within logs.

We work with teams like Skydio and Zeitview, and recently built
functionality for Zipline that I think could be particularly relevant to
[COMPANY] - e.g. a data management platform that helps teams curate large
datasets and quickly find the most relevant moments in video using
embeddings, similarity, and natural language search.

Zeitview were able to double their dataset size and throughout while
reducing team size - you can find the case study here
<[LINK]>
.

Would you be open to a quick call to see whether this could be useful for
[COMPANY], now or in the future? Monday or Thursday next week would work on our
side but happy to flex.

subject: Coffee in Austin - Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I was in touch with Jaewoon earlier this year - sounds like improving pick
& place accuracy is a focus for your team. He also mentioned you're the
best person to connect with on annotation pipeline - so I was wondering if
you'd be open to a coffee while we're in Austin?

From our perspectives - label accuracy is an area we can explore. We've
been solving similar challenges with Osaro, Ambi Robotics and Pickle Robot
- whom similar to Contoro requires precise segmentation + 3D -> 2D
projection.

Would love to get your thoughts on annotation pipeline automation &
accuracy. We'll be in town Wed (10/19) and Thurs (10/20) next week - would
sometime in the afternoon work for a coffee?
